capacity_usable_kwh.notes: VinFast US MY27 spec sheet: 123 kWh usable. 2024-2025 North American cars assumed the same (EVspecs/Wikipedia); a 92 kWh pack exists in other markets.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: VinFast US charging page describes only app cabin pre-heat/pre-cool; the MY27 VF 9 spec sheet lists a High Voltage Battery Heater (automatic, not a user feature). No battery-preconditioning-for-charging feature found. Owner manual not found. No owner's manual or maker statement found; owner decision requested.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists a 400 V architecture for the VF 9 Extended Range (123 kWh usable, search excerpt; page returned 429 when opened); no page opened states the voltage.

dc_max_kw.notes: 150 kW DC (EVspecs.org); VinFast states 10-70 % in 35 min. VinFast US sheet gives only 10-70 % in 35 min; EVspecs.org labels 150 kW "DC Fast Charging", not "max" (one review says up to 160 kW).
